args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_cents, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'West' AND o.status = 'completed'
AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
SELECT order_ts, typeof(order_ts) FROM memory.bench.orders LIMIT 3
SELECT MIN(order_ts), MAX(order_ts) FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
